newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in the after-hours session on Thursday, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.9 yen per kg firmer from the day's close. Benchmark June was up 0.3 yen at 146.4 yen. Volume was 3,975 lots.
During the day prices edged up on technical buying, but hedge selling ahead of the close cut some of the early gains.
"Market direction hinges on the currency market. We are watching how far the yen will fall," one trader said.
